"Electrification first," he argues, acknowledging that this "doesn't necessarily mean clean electricity." His argument is grounded in a critical assessment of international climate diplomacy and European energy policy. "We've seen many COPs, and they've all failed," he contends, questioning the effectiveness of ambitious targets that have yet to deliver the necessary structural transformation.
